<subject>ResoSanté Email Undeliverable: Cannot locate you</subject>
<body>
We received your email addressed to p953@trialttech.com. Unfortunately, we cannot find your username or email address listed as a current member or subscriber of ResoSanté.

Membership at ResoSanté is free and allows you to search the profiles of thousands of healthcare professionals, post your own profile, view your best clinical matches, receive new matches by email, and more. But to make direct contact with profiles that catch your eye, you must join as a paid subscriber. For details, click here: https://www.medconnectgroup.com/

If you are a current subscriber and believe you've received this email in error, please contact our Legal & Compliance team at: suzanne.bodin@lumieresante.fr

For your convenience, we've included the text of your personal message below:

To: p953@trialttech.com
Subject: RE: ResoSanté - You've Got Mail: Hi Plucci!
Hello,

Thanks for sending me an email. I appreciate the interest and found your profile to be interesting as well. But, I feel I'm at a disadvantage due to the fact that your profile doesn't contain a picture. Are you sending a picture over later, or making me guess as to what you look like? Drop me a line and we can hash this out.

Antoine
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: p953@trialttech.com
Sent: Saturday, 22 November 2025 14:39
To: lucas.lopes@lumieresante.fr
Subject: ResoSanté - You've Got Mail: Hi Plucci!


Hi - I'll be honest - I thought you were cute. Hopefully you are as interesting as you are attractive :)

Take a look at my profile and send me an e-mail if you'd like. Hope to hear from you!

Click the following link to view the sender's profile:
https://www.medconnectgroup.com/
rackingid=0

The following is my profile text:

I never thought I'd be using a "professional networking service". But I'm open to trying new things - so let's give it a try. I'm an outgoing, positive, fun person. I LOVE to travel and experience new places and cultures. I'm always learning something new - right now it's the guitar. I'm also really happy being alone with myself to read, write, or just putz around. I love kids, and they love me - probably because I'm pretty much a kid at heart still. I'm very close to my family and have probably too many good friends - I spend a lot of time keeping up with them all.

*********************************************************

ADDITIONAL TIPS from ResoSanté:

Our anonymous re-mailer will strip away your real email address, so 
that it will NOT appear in the 'From:' line.

You may also contact this person from their ResoSanté profile by 
clicking 'Contact this person' and composing your message directly from
the 
site.

However:

* Check to ensure that your email address is not in the BODY of your 
message as we are unable to remove these.

* Check to ensure that you REMOVE ANY AUTOMATIC SIGNATURE at the end of 

your email. And note that you cannot use 'Cc:' or 'Bcc:' if you want 
your email to remain anonymous.

ResoSanté does not monitor private email between members, nor are we 
liable for the content of these messages. All members are bound by our 
Professional Conduct Charter.
